business_summary: Better Life Commercial Chain Share Co.,Ltd engages in commercial retail business in China. The company involved in e-commerce, including fresh food, imported food, beauty and personal care, kitchen and bath, maternity products and toys, electrical equipment and appliances, home and sports, nutrition and health care, watches and jewelry, clothing, shoes and hats, air tickets, and products of brand flagship stores; food business; operating department stores for selling bedding, bolster, blanket , floor mat, household articles, decorative candle, tableware, tea set, cookware, small appliance, and so forth, as well as sells clothing, shoes, bags, children's wear, and household articles, electronic appliances, and commercial real estate development business. It also provides financing services, which include small credit loans and financial counseling service for issues of agriculture, farmer, and rural area, as well as supply chain clients, logistics, and operation and management of commercial centers. In addition, the company operates convenient store for package food, consumptive daily necessities, instant food and several attached services, such as printing and copying, free warming, free hot water, free local call, recharge of water, electricity and gas, as well as credit card payment, receiving and sending packages of EMS and S.F. Express for consumers; and food courts and theme restaurants. It offers its consumer goods and commodity retail services through supermarkets, department stores and other retail formats. The company was formerly known as Better Life Commercial Chain Limited Liability Company. Better Life Commercial Chain Share Co.,Ltd was founded in 1995 and is based in Xiangtan, China.
business_summary_ko: Better Life Commercial Chain Share Co.,Ltd는 중국에서 상업 소매 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 신선식품, 수입식품, 뷰티 및 퍼스널 케어, 주방 및 욕실, 임산부 용품 및 장난감, 전기 장비 및 가전제품, 가정 및 스포츠, 영양 및 건강 관리, 시계 및 보석류, 의류, 신발 및 모자, 항공권, 브랜드 플래그십 스토어 제품을 포함한 전자 상거래에 종사하는 회사입니다. 식품사업; 침구, 볼스터, 담요, 플로어매트, 생활용품, 장식양초, 식기류, 다기세트, 조리기구, 소형가전 등을 판매하는 백화점을 운영하고 있으며, 의류, 신발, 가방, 아동복, 가정용품, 전자제품, 상업용 부동산 개발사업 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 또한, 농업·농업·농촌 문제에 대한 소액신용대출, 금융상담 서비스, 공급망 고객, 물류, 상업센터 운영·관리 등 금융 서비스도 제공하고 있다. 또한, 포장식품, 소모성 생활필수품, 즉석식품 등 각종 부대서비스(인쇄, 복사, 무료 데우기 등)를 취급하는 편의점을 운영하고 있습니다.
